Kuvitus: biljardipöytä läheltä nähtynä p: Illustration: a billiard table seen close up in the light of a lamp hanging above it. A cue points onto the table from the lower left, and has just struck the white cue ball. The cue ball has hit a red ball head-on, and a moment after the collision it has stopped in the middle of the table; a faint trail behind it shows the distance it travelled. The red ball speeds ahead towards the right edge of the table, with motion lines behind it. At the back of the table there are three more balls.
Kaavakuva, ei mittakaavassa: kaksi ilmat: Diagram, not to scale: two air-track carts during a collision. The spring bumper between the carts is compressed. At the top are red force arrows: cart 1 pushes cart 2 to the right with a force F, and cart 2 pushes cart 1 to the left with an equally large force in the opposite direction, −F. Both forces act for the same time Δt. At the bottom the purple arrows are the changes in momentum: the change of cart 1, Δp1 = −FΔt, points to the left and that of cart 2, Δp2 = FΔt, to the right, equally long. Their sum is zero.
Kaavakuva mittakaavassa: kaksi samanmass: Diagram to scale: two carts of equal mass on an air track, before the collision at the top and after it at the bottom. Before the collision cart 1 moves to the right at velocity v, and its momentum p is a purple arrow; cart 2 is at rest. The ends of the carts have hook-and-loop tape. After the collision the carts have stuck together and move together at half of the original velocity; the blue arrow is half as long. The purple arrow of the common momentum is as long as the momentum of cart 1 before the collision.
Kaavakuva, liikemäärät mittakaavassa: ko: Diagram, momenta to scale: three events for two carts of equal mass, before on the left and after on the right. At the top an elastic collision: before, cart 1 has a momentum to the right and cart 2 is at rest; after, cart 1 is at rest and cart 2 has the same momentum; kinetic energy is conserved. In the middle a perfectly inelastic collision: the carts stick together, and the common momentum is as large as before; kinetic energy decreases. At the bottom an explosion: before, the carts are together at rest and the total momentum is zero; after, the carts have momenta of equal magnitude in opposite directions; kinetic energy increases.
Kuvaaja mittakaavassa: kahden ilmatyynyr: Graph to scale: the velocity of two air-track gliders, A and B, as a function of time, positive direction to the right. Until 2.0 seconds the velocity of glider A is 0.8 metres per second and the velocity of glider B is minus 0.4 metres per second. The collision happens at 2.0 seconds. After the collision the velocity of glider A is 0.2 metres per second and the velocity of glider B is 0.6 metres per second. On the horizontal axis time 0–4 seconds at 0.5 second intervals, on the vertical axis velocity −0.6–1.0 metres per second at intervals of 0.2 metres per second.

Graph to scale: the position x of two air-track gliders, A and B, as a function of time, positive direction to the right. Glider B is at rest at the position 0.60 metres. Glider A starts at position 0 at time 0 and moves at a steady velocity to the position 0.60 metres by 1.0 seconds. Then the gliders collide and stick together. Together they move at a steady velocity to the position 1.00 metres by 3.0 seconds. On the horizontal axis time 0–3 seconds at 0.5 second intervals, on the vertical axis position 0–1.2 metres at 0.2 metre intervals.
